title: Qué tuani
desc: A word you learned from a teenager, said to a grandmother
setting: Doña Chepa's shop, Saturday morning, and there is an eighty-year-old woman buying bread beside you.

steps.speaker: Señora
steps.es: ¿Y cómo le va aquí en Managua, mijo?
steps.en: And how are you getting on here in Managua, son?

options.es: Muy bien, señora. Aquí muy contento.
options.en: Very well, señora. Very happy here.
options.feedback: Plain, warm, and pitched at her age. That is all this question ever wanted.
Correct. Señora would have cost you nothing and bought a lot.
The word is not wrong. In front of a woman of eighty, out of a married man's mouth, it is the wrong word.

steps.speaker: Doña Chepa
steps.es: Bueno... aquí tiene su pan, doña Julia.
steps.en: Well... here is your bread, doña Julia.

options.es: Que le vaya bien, doña Julia.
options.feedback: You caught the name and used it. The room was awkward and you made it ordinary again.
Adiós to somebody walking out of a shop still sounds bigger than it is.
Drawing attention to it in front of her is worse than the word was.

steps.speaker: Doña Chepa
steps.es: Mijo. Esa palabra es de chavalos.
steps.en: Son. That word is for kids.

options.es: Puchica. ¿Y con quién sí se puede decir?
options.en: Damn. And who can it be said with, then?
options.feedback: Took the correction and asked the useful follow-up. That is how the rest of the slang gets learned safely.
Fine, and it ends the lesson she was about to give you for free.

options.es: Roberto la dice todo el tiempo.
options.en: Roberto says it all the time.
options.feedback: He is seventeen. That is the entire point she is making.

steps.speaker: Doña Chepa
steps.es: Entre amigos sí. Con una señora mayor no.
steps.en: Among friends yes. With an older lady no.

options.en: Understood. Tuani I can use, right?
options.feedback: You checked the neighbouring word instead of guessing. That is exactly the habit to build.

options.es: Ya no la voy a decir.
options.en: I am not going to say it any more.
options.feedback: Safe, and it throws away a good word instead of learning where it lives.

options.es: Es que ustedes son muy delicados.
options.feedback: Ustedes, and a verdict, thirty seconds after being helped.
